title: How one storefront becomes a chain

captions.instagram:
In 1976, my father opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street in Brooklyn. One storefront, one name: Nobody Beats The Wiz.

A store runs on its owner. A chain runs on systems. Two of the Wiz positioning pillars were a scalable concept and operational support.

Are you thinking about a second location?
captions.linkedin:
A store depends on its owner. A chain depends on systems.

In 1976, my father opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street in Brooklyn. Two of the Wiz positioning pillars speak directly to growth: a scalable concept and operational support.

Before you scale, I'd ask:
1. Does it work in one place?
2. Can it be written down?
3. Can someone else run it?
4. Can you fund the next one?
5. Will customers recognize it?
